Dense fitted sections — BLAZING olive-green unakite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID salmon-pink speckles flowing through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Everywhere else, including her bust, the unakite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#1: Pose: walking mid-stride toward the camera, both arms swinging naturally at her sides — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
